cases.name: plain gap on the root session
coalesced bracket keeps the first after and extends next, recorded verbatim
overlapping bracket from a later hole is a separate verbatim record, never merged
foreign session gap is recorded under its own session id, not the root's
malformed gap without cursors is recorded with nulls, not dropped

comment: view/gap params (schema ViewGapParams) -> the recorded gap_fill observation. Cursors are opaque (SS4.1): they are relayed byte-exact, never parsed, ordered or merged. A run of undelivered events coalesces into one bracket keeping the FIRST range's after; a later bracket may overlap an earlier one, and the bridge records each verbatim instead of reasoning about the overlap. at_ms is supplied by the caller and asserted by shape, not value.
